title: Juvenile caught with pistol, drug paraphernalia in Meriden, police say - NewsBreak
text:
By Richard Chumney ,
5 hours ago Meriden police arrested a juvenile Wednesday after he was caught with a firearm and drug paraphernalia on East Main Street, officials said. (Courtesy of the Meriden Police Department) MERIDEN — Police arrested a juvenile Wednesday after he was caught with a firearm and drug paraphernalia on East Main Street, officials said.
Officers detained the individual around 11:47 p.m. after they approached him and he attempted to run away, according to the Meriden Police Department.
Police said officers were patrolling the area due to its history of narcotic-related activity, fights, trespassing and the “reckless use of the highway by pedestrians.”
After apprehending the juvenile, officers found drug paraphernalia and a 9mm Glock-style pistol with no serial number, police said.
Police said the juvenile was transported to a Hartford Juvenile Detention facility after a judge approved an order to detain. The department did not share the individual's age.
The juvenile was charged with carrying a pistol without a permit, possession of a firearm without a serial number, inferring with officers, possession of drug paraphernalia, reckless use of a highway by pedestrian, obstruction by loitering and a curfew violation.
